title: Charlotte nonprofits brace for summer hunger surge
summary_or_snippet: Axios Charlotte reported that Charlotte nonprofits are preparing for a summer hunger spike as school meals end, Nourish Up serves about 12,000 households each month, and SNAP changes add pressure for families.
evidence_text: Axios Charlotte reported that Charlotte nonprofits are preparing for a summer hunger spike as school meals end. Nourish Up serves about 12,000 households each month. About 68,000 Charlotte-Mecklenburg Schools students receive free meals during the school year, and the group says it needs more delivery drivers as summer demand rises and SNAP eligibility changes add pressure for families.
